```{r}
# Install if needed
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages("BiocManager")


# Load
library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(Biobase)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
gse <- getGEO("GSE45164", destdir = ".", getGPL = TRUE)
if (length(gse) > 1) idx <- grep("GPL571", attr(gse, "names")) else idx <- 1
gse <- gse[[idx]]

# 2. Extract Expression Matrix (already log2 transformed usually) and Metadata
exprs_mat <- exprs(gse)
metadata <- pData(gse)

```
```{r}
metadata <- metadata %>%
  select(title, characteristics_ch1) %>%
  mutate(Condition = ifelse(grepl("SCC", title), "cSCC", "Normal"))
```

```{r}
# 4. Map Probes to Symbols
feature_data <- fData(gse) # Contains Probe to Symbol mapping
probe_mapping <- feature_data %>%
  select(ID, Symbol = `Gene Symbol`) %>%
  filter(Symbol != "")

# See the column names
colnames(fData(gse))

# Look at the first few rows to spot the symbols
head(fData(gse))

# Extract specific genes of interest
target_genes <- c("TWIST1", "OVOL1", "KLF4", "IVL", "LOR", "KRT1", "KRT10", "MYC", "MAPKAPK2")
selected_probes <- probe_mapping %>%
  filter(Symbol %in% target_genes)

# Create a clean expression matrix with Gene Symbols
clean_exprs <- exprs_mat[selected_probes$ID, ]
rownames(clean_exprs) <- selected_probes$Symbol
```

```{r}
# Prepare plotting data
plot_df <- as.data.frame(t(clean_exprs))
plot_df$Condition <- metadata$Condition

library(ggpubr)
clean_exprs_unique <- avereps(clean_exprs, ID = rownames(clean_exprs))

# 2. Re-create the plotting data frame
plot_df <- as.data.frame(t(clean_exprs_unique))

# 3. Re-attach the Condition metadata
# Ensure the order matches (it should, as we only transposed the rows)
plot_df$Condition <- metadata$Condition

# 4. Now the Scatter Plot will work because 'TWIST1' is a unique column name
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = TWIST1, y = OVOL1)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Condition), size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "GSE45164: TWIST1 vs OVOL1 Inverse Correlation",
    subtitle = "Averaged probes per gene symbol",
    x = "TWIST1 Expression (log2 Intensity)",
    y = "OVOL1 Expression (log2 Intensity)"
  )
```
FACET BY CONDITION
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(limma)

# 1. Consolidate duplicate probes (important for Affymetrix GPL571)
clean_exprs_unique <- avereps(clean_exprs, ID = rownames(clean_exprs))

# 2. Re-create the plotting data frame
plot_df <- as.data.frame(t(clean_exprs_unique))

# 3. Re-attach the Condition metadata from your object
plot_df$Condition <- metadata$Condition

# 4. Generate the Faceted Scatter Plot
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = TWIST1, y = OVOL1)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Condition), size = 4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed", se = TRUE) +
  # This will now calculate a separate Rho and p-value for each facet
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "top") + 
  # THE KEY ADDITION:
  facet_wrap(~Condition, scales = "free") + 
  theme_bw() + # theme_bw often looks cleaner with facets
  labs(
    title = "GSE45164: TWIST1 vs OVOL1 Expression by Group",
    subtitle = "Averaged probes; Faceted by Condition",
    x = "TWIST1 Expression (log2 Intensity)",
    y = "OVOL1 Expression (log2 Intensity)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") # Legend is redundant when faceted
```



```{r}
# Calculate Spearman Correlation Matrix
cor_mat <- cor(t(clean_exprs), method = "spearman")

# Plot Heatmap
library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(cor_mat[c("TWIST1", "OVOL1"), ], 
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         main = "Correlation: TWIST1/OVOL1 vs. Markers (GSE45164)",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "white", "darkred"))(100))
```
```{r}
# Reshape for boxplot
long_df <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Condition, names_to = "Gene", values_to = "Expression") %>%
  filter(Gene %in% c("TWIST1", "OVOL1"))

ggplot(long_df, aes(x = Condition, y = Expression, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test") +
  labs(title = "Shift in Expression: Normal vs. cSCC")
```
